body: The addition of an identity probe for agents with clashing binary names is a sound and well-implemented safety enhancement. It correctly mitigates the risk of launching the wrong binary by running a help-probe (`--help`) before the actual agent launch. The implementation covers all required surfaces, including documentation (`manual.md`, `troubleshooting.md`), refusal codes, usage instructions, and rigorous evals, including a dedicated new case `run-agent-probe.sh`.

comments.text: The usage text now correctly includes the expanded agent list and explains the new binary clash probe mechanism.
The logic for the identity probe correctly handles non-zero exits, timeouts, and missing match text, ensuring safety before agent launch.
This new test case provides excellent coverage of the probe behavior, validating both successful launches and proper refusal (`agent-mismatch`) in the face of name clashes.
